layout.downfilter: GPU linear 2x2 area average of all premultiplied RGBA16Float channels; no normal/depth normalization before runtime coverage division
layout.hemisphere: full-sphere octahedral: raw=(u,1-abs(u)-abs(v),v); when y<0 fold x=(1-abs(v))*sign(u),z=(1-abs(u))*sign(v), retaining negative y; normalize; u,v in [-1,1]

channels.albedo: Little-endian RGBA16Float: unlit linear diffuse RGB premultiplied by coverage, A=coverage
channels.normalDepth: Little-endian RGBA16Float: local normal XYZ, normalized front depth; all channels premultiplied by the same resolved coverage. Divide by albedo.A; normalize normal.
channels.reconstruction: local=projection.centre+right*((2*tileU-1)*extent)+up*((1-2*tileV)*extent)+direction*(extent-2*extent*depth); source local.y<projection.groundPlaneY is occluded by soil
channels.coverage: Native filtered alpha with deterministic ordered four-sample coverage at 2x capture; all channels GPU area-averaged 2x2 to 16 samples/final pixel. Per-covered capture sample returns A=1. No fixed native MASK cutoff is applied to averaged foliage mips. Transmission is not opacity.
channels.png: albedo.png is an unpremultiplied sRGB/coverage inspection derivative. preview.png is four above-ground native256px shaded projections, not normative albedo.

source.geometry: Exact v2/56B vertices and full detailed wood+leaf triangle membership; far ranges never rendered; immutable geometry. Native material slot and UV unchanged. Local Y<0 fragments are soil-occluded; projection bounds include exact triangle/ground intersections, not buried support.

limitations: Full-sphere view support includes lower-canopy views; interpolation/parallax still require qualification.
No animated wind is baked. No source canopy shell, thinned leaves or generic foliage is substituted.
Atlas view interpolation, parallax error and projected 3px transition require runtime qualification; this bake does not certify them.
Roughness/transmission maps and scalars retain their native receipts but are not per-pixel channels in this two-atlas representation.

directFar.colourSource: Embedded albedo integrated in linear light, alpha-weighted; foliage weighted by source triangle count

catalogEntry.foliageRepresentation: native-size individual cutouts and needle geometry
limitations: Mobile frame rate needs device validation, especially needle-heavy trees.
Unresolved blade positions are render quadrature, not new shoots.
Web thin-sheet transmission and underside shader are not encoded in USD Preview Surface.

cohort.claim: Existing mature baked source; no growth, remeshing or current-engine identity asserted
